Alex R: Heads-up — I ran the arch-cap probe on the new cluster and we're getting inconsistent capability flags for a subset of A100-ish nodes. some report FP8 support when the driver actually doesn't expose tc fp8 symbols. logs below.

Alex R: ```
probe: device=gpu-17 sm=8.6 driver=525.85
cap_flags: tensorcores=true bf16=true fp8=true
kernels: chosen=fp8_fastpath sequence_len=128
error: kernel_launch: invalid_kernel_variant, falling back
```

Sasha P: ugh. looks like the probe is relying on heuristic hw-signature->cap mapping. did you run the driver symbol check? we should prefer explicit runtime feature check before enabling fp8 kernels.

Mike L: saw the same on perf job 2026-03-10. end-to-end latency jumps ~18% when we misroute to fp8 and then fallback — double launch + kvcache miss. I have the microbench numbers.

Mike L: short summary:
- correct path (bf16) avg p95 = 42ms
- misroute(fp8 then fallback) avg p95 = 50ms
- extra memory churn from failed fp8 path evicts hot kv cache entries, +12ms tail

Tara K: that kvcache thrash is the kicker. when fallback occurs we invalidate the prefix cache for that stream; small batches + seq=128 are most vulnerable. we should add a hysteresis: avoid selecting fp8 path unless seq_len <= 64 AND tensorcore_probe==true AND driver_fp8_symbol==true.

Alex R: proposed patch sketch:
```json
{
  "kernel_picker": {
    "seqlen_threshold_for_fp8": 64,
    "require_runtime_symbol": true,
    "fallback_policy": "no-evict-on-soft-fallback"
  }
}
```

Sasha P: +1 to runtime symbol check. also add a grace window after a fallback so we don't flip-flop per-request. e.g., mark device as soft-unavailable for 30s after N soft-fallbacks.

Mike L: I can add a microbenchmark that intentionally probes fp8 path and measures kv eviction impact. will post results by EOD. @Tara K can you spec the hysteresis?

Tara K: will do. thinking: 2 soft-fallbacks within 60s => mark ephemeral blacklist for 30s, and during blacklist prefer bf16/baseline kernels. will add unit tests for prefix cache retention (no eviction on soft-fallback).

infra-bot: rollout plan created: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollout/4621 — feature-flag=arch-probe-runtime-check. staged to dev, canary to follow.

ci-bot: perf-tests/arch-probe (linux) failing on canary: 3 tests show kernel mismatch on sm86 simulated farm. logs attached.

Alex R: ok action items:
- Mike: microbench + perf numbers (p95/p99, kv eviction traces) — due EOD
- Tara: hysteresis + tests + config defaults — due tomorrow
- Sasha: add runtime symbol check + grace-window to probe flow, update rollout docs — due tomorrow
- Infra: gate rollout behind the perf-tests fix, canary 10% then 50%

Alex R: tagging owners in case anyone else wants in: @Sasha P @Mike L @Tara K. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if we get a regression in prod. :eyes:
